name: @nawara/e2e-real-broker
description: Real-broker loops between live processes: Stage 5 hardening (the Billing/Payment Stage 4 loop) and Stage 16.5 (real Auth -> RabbitMQ -> notification-service intake), over a REAL RabbitMQ broker and real HTTP between two live processes — never one process's TypeScript imported by the other (services talk over APIs and events only; see scripts/lib/checks.mjs). Needs the services already built (npm run build -w @nawara/service-kit -w billing-service -w payment-service -w auth-service -w notification-service).
